No video today, but we still managed to get a few words from the gaffer after today’s defeat. 

“Despite the result, I thought we created more than enough chances to win today’s game. Unfortunately, a mistake from our young goalkeeper proved costly, but that’s football and he’ll learn from it with our full support.

I also felt we should have been awarded a penalty for the foul on Callum Parker, which could have changed the outcome.

There were plenty of positives in our performance, and if we continue to create chances like that, the results will keep coming.”

0-2 | @TelfordTownFC

A ball over the Telford defence. @Harleyrenshaw11 doesn’t give up and forces the error leading to the ball rolling past the goal-line! 👏

Still time left! 💪

2-3 | @TelfordTownFC
